lib.title: Media
lib.emptyText: Click here or drag files anywhere on the window.
lib.notMedia: “{{name}}” could not be read. Try MP4, MOV, WebM, MP3, WAV, JPG or PNG.
lib.cantPlay: “{{name}}” uses a format this computer cannot decode.
lib.cantPlayShort: This computer cannot decode this video format.
lib.add: Add to timeline (or drag it there)
lib.textHint: Click a style to add a title at the red line. Then type your text on the right.

player.empty: Import videos, then drag them to the timeline below.

insp.title: Details
insp.none: Select something in the media library.
insp.name: Name
insp.clipHint: Drag the clip to move it, drag its edges to trim it, press S to cut it at the red line.
insp.dragHint: Tip: drag the clip in the player to move it, drag a corner to resize, the round handle to turn it.
insp.trHint: The two clips overlap during the transition, so the video gets a little shorter.

tl.splitTip: Cut the clip at the red line (S)
tl.snap: Snap to edges and the red line
tl.emptyMain: Drag videos and pictures here (or double-click them in Media)
tl.dropOverlay: Drop here to put it on top of the video

file.notProject: This is not an EasyStudio Video project.
file.newer: This project was made with a newer version of the app.
file.missing: Some files were not found (moved or deleted): {{names}}
file.discard: You have unsaved changes. Continue without saving them?

exp.title: Export video
exp.q_mediumTip: Good quality, normal size — for YouTube, Instagram, TikTok
exp.mp4Tip: MP4 plays everywhere: phones, TVs, YouTube, WhatsApp. Recommended.
exp.webmTip: WebM is smaller, good for websites; some TVs and phones cannot play it.
exp.runningHint: Your graphics card is making the video. You can keep this window open until it is done.
exp.noEncoder: This computer cannot make this kind of video at this size. Try MP4 at a smaller resolution.
exp.noAudioEncoder: This computer cannot encode sound for this file type — the video will be silent. Try MP4.
exp.desktopOnly: Exporting works in the desktop app.
exp.watermarkNote: Free version: 1080p videos get a small “Made with EasyStudio” mark in the corner (720p has none). Pro removes it.

rec.title: Your last video was not saved
rec.text: The app closed unexpectedly while “{{name}}” was open. A copy from {{time}} was kept.
rec.done: Your video is back. Save it (Ctrl+S) to keep it.

help.title: Help and shortcuts
help.k_split: Cut the clip at the red line

tour.mediaText: Import videos, music and pictures here (or drag them onto the window). The Text tab has ready-made titles.
tour.timelineText: Drag files down here to build your video. Drag clips to move them, drag their edges to trim, press S to cut at the red line.
tour.playerText: Press Space to play. Select a clip to move or resize it right here in the picture.
tour.inspectorText: Speed, volume, fades, colours, filters, transitions and title text — for the selected clip.
tour.exportText: When you are happy, Export makes an MP4 for YouTube, TikTok, Instagram or WhatsApp.

proBenefits.watermark: No “Made with EasyStudio” mark on 1080p videos
proBenefits.future: Every new Pro feature in future updates
